note: Putnam County (IL) publishes its zoning only as the 2016 zoning ordinance PDF with district maps adopted into it (updated Sept 2024 PDF on putnamil.gov). Its GIS Mapping Tool (putnam-il.bhamaps.com, Supervisor of Assessments) is a viewer whose REST root returns 403 Access Denied, and putnamil.wthgis.com has no REST root. No public ArcGIS REST zoning district layer was found for the county or for Hennepin, Granville or Standard.
